{{Top|leg}}
'''Vine-trees''' were a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The rooftop of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] was covered in huge vine-trees.
